Introduction: This Privacy Policy explains how Zeyrix ("Zeyrix," "we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, stores, and shares personal information when you visit our website, use our services, or interact with ZeyrixAI, our AI-powered demonstration agent.

Zeyrix is a developing software and technology project intended to provide software development services to individuals and businesses internationally. ZeyrixAI is a demonstration of our technical capabilities and is not intended to serve as a substitute for professional, legal, medical, financial, or other specialized advice.

This Privacy Policy applies to our website, ZeyrixAI, and any other services that link to or expressly incorporate this policy. Additional terms or privacy notices may apply to specific services or features.

By using our services, you acknowledge that you have had the opportunity to read this Privacy Policy. Where applicable law requires consent for a particular processing activity, we will seek that consent separately. Nothing in this policy limits rights that cannot lawfully be waived.

Zeyrix is currently under development, and its infrastructure, integrations, and features may change before and after launch. We will update this Privacy Policy when material changes to our data processing practices require it.
Information We Collect: Telegram Account Information: When you authenticate through Telegram, we receive and store your Telegram user ID in its original form, along with any additional information made available through the authentication process that is necessary to establish or maintain your account. We do not represent that we receive or store your Telegram password.

Account Preferences: We may store preferences associated with your account, including your preferred language and time zone. These preferences are used to personalize the service and provide an appropriate user experience.

Session and Technical Information: We store technical information associated with user sessions, including IP addresses and user-agent strings. User-agent information may reveal details such as your browser, operating system, and device type. We may also process technical information generated by requests to our servers to maintain the service, diagnose errors, protect infrastructure, and investigate abuse.

Conversations and Messages: When you interact with ZeyrixAI, we store chat records, messages, and associated conversation metadata in our database so that conversations can be maintained and relevant history can be made available to the agent. We do not intentionally record every conversation in full in our application-level backend logs; however, the actual conversation content is stored separately as part of the chat and message data.

Prompts and User Content: We process the text, instructions, questions, and other content you submit to ZeyrixAI. This may include information contained in prompts, follow-up messages, and other content provided during a conversation.

Uploaded Files and Media: You may submit documents, images, and other supported files to ZeyrixAI. If voice input is supported, your voice recordings or associated audio data may also be processed. Depending on the feature and processing workflow, audio may be transcribed or otherwise processed to generate a response. Uploaded content may contain personal information about you or other individuals.

Generated Content and Files: ZeyrixAI may generate responses, documents, images, or other files. We may store generated files and related metadata so that they can be delivered to you or remain accessible through supported features.

Local Browser Storage: Our website may use browser cookies, local storage, and IndexedDB to maintain necessary functionality and preferences. In particular, files uploaded to or generated by ZeyrixAI may be stored in IndexedDB in your browser. Such locally stored files may remain on your device after a conversation or browser session ends, depending on how the application manages them and your browser's storage behavior.

Information We Do Not Intentionally Collect for Analytics: We do not currently use dedicated third-party analytics platforms, advertising networks, or marketing email services as part of the planned service configuration described by this policy. This statement does not exclude technical logging required to operate and secure the service or logging performed independently by infrastructure and AI providers.
How We Use Information: Service Operation: We use information to authenticate users, maintain accounts and sessions, provide access to features, process requests, deliver AI-generated responses, and operate the website and related services.

AI Processing: We use submitted prompts, conversation history, uploaded files, and relevant preferences to provide context to ZeyrixAI and obtain responses from the AI models and tools required to fulfill a request.

Web Search and External Tools: When a request requires web search or another external capability, relevant queries or other necessary information may be transmitted to third-party providers to retrieve results or complete the requested operation.

Conversation Continuity: We store chat histories and messages to preserve conversations and make relevant context available during subsequent interactions. Depending on the feature, the agent may access prior messages or attached content within the context provided to it.
Preferences and Localization: We use language and time-zone preferences to provide localized responses and a more convenient user experience.

Security and Abuse Prevention: We may process session identifiers, IP addresses, user-agent strings, request metadata, and other relevant technical information to authenticate requests, detect misuse, protect infrastructure, investigate security incidents, and enforce access restrictions.

Maintenance and Improvement: We may use operational metadata, error information, and diagnostic information to troubleshoot failures, assess reliability, and maintain our services. We do not intentionally include complete conversation contents in our application-level backend logs, but this does not guarantee that content is absent from logs or records maintained by third-party providers.

Communications and Privacy Requests: We may use information you provide when contacting us to respond to questions, handle support requests, process privacy requests, and communicate material information about our services or policies.

Legal Compliance: We may process or disclose information when reasonably necessary to comply with applicable law, respond to lawful requests, protect rights and safety, or establish, exercise, or defend legal claims, subject to applicable legal requirements.
ZeyrixAI and Sensitive Information: ZeyrixAI is a demonstration service intended to illustrate Zeyrix's technical capabilities. Although we aim to develop and operate it responsibly, it should not be treated as a confidential environment or as a service designed to handle sensitive or regulated information.

Do not submit passwords, authentication credentials, payment card details, government identification numbers, private encryption keys, medical records, confidential business information, trade secrets, or other sensitive personal or confidential information unless you have independently assessed the risks and have a lawful basis to provide that information.

AI responses may be inaccurate, incomplete, misleading, or inappropriate for your circumstances. Do not rely on ZeyrixAI as the sole basis for important decisions or use it as a replacement for qualified professional advice.

To generate responses, ZeyrixAI may transmit prompts, relevant conversation history, uploaded files, extracted text, images, audio, and other necessary content to external AI or web-search providers. The information transmitted depends on the feature used, the provider selected, and the processing workflow.

We may use multiple AI and web-search providers, and the providers available to the service may change over time. Different providers may have different data retention, logging, security, and model-training practices. Some providers may retain submitted content or use it to improve or train their models, subject to their applicable terms, settings, and policies. We do not guarantee that every provider disables training, does not retain prompts, or deletes submitted content immediately.

Where available and technically feasible, we may configure provider settings or select processing options intended to reduce unnecessary retention or use of submitted content. Such measures do not constitute a guarantee that every provider processes data identically or that all provider-side retention can be prevented.

You should review the applicable third-party providers' privacy policies and terms where available and avoid submitting information that you are not comfortable transmitting to those providers. If you submit personal information relating to another individual, you are responsible for ensuring that you are legally permitted to do so.
Cookies and Browser Storage: We may use cookies and similar browser technologies that are necessary for the operation and security of our website and services. Depending on the implementation, these may include session or authentication cookies and cookies or other storage mechanisms used to remember language preferences or maintain essential application state.

We may also use local storage or similar browser mechanisms to preserve interface preferences, such as navigation state, where implemented. These mechanisms are distinct from cookies and may be managed separately by your browser.

IndexedDB may be used to store uploaded files, generated files, or other content locally in your browser to support application functionality. Local copies are stored on your device rather than solely in our remote database and may remain there until removed by the application, overwritten, or deleted through your browser's site-data controls. We do not guarantee that closing a tab or signing out automatically removes these local copies.

You can manage or clear cookies and website storage through your browser settings. Blocking or clearing necessary storage may cause authentication, preferences, file access, or other features to stop working correctly.

If we introduce analytics, advertising, or other non-essential tracking technologies in the future, we will update this policy and obtain consent where required by applicable law before using technologies that require such consent.
How We Share Information: Infrastructure and Hosting Providers: We use third-party infrastructure to operate our services, which may include application hosting, database hosting, caching, file storage, networking, and security services. These providers may process or store account information, session data, conversations, files, and technical information as necessary to provide their services.

AI Providers: We transmit information necessary to generate responses to external AI providers. Depending on the request, this may include prompts, relevant conversation history, uploaded content, extracted text, images, audio, and other contextual information.

Web Search and Tool Providers: When ZeyrixAI uses external search or other tools, relevant search queries, instructions, or other necessary information may be shared with the provider responsible for that operation.

File Storage: Uploaded and AI-generated files may be stored using Cloudflare R2 or another configured storage provider. File storage and retrieval may involve file contents, object identifiers, metadata, and technical information necessary to manage access and delivery.

Changing Providers: The specific hosting, infrastructure, AI, and web-search providers we use may change as the service develops. We may use multiple providers for different operations. We do not promise that the provider list will remain fixed, and the data sent to any particular provider depends on the operation performed.

Service Providers' Independent Practices: Third-party providers may process information under their own terms and privacy policies, including where they act as independent controllers or otherwise determine certain aspects of their processing. Our contractual arrangements and configuration may vary by provider. We cannot guarantee or independently control every aspect of a provider's internal logging, retention, or model-training practices.

Legal and Safety Disclosures: We may disclose information when required by applicable law or valid legal process, or when reasonably necessary to protect our users, services, rights, property, or safety, subject to applicable law.

Business Transfers: If Zeyrix undergoes a merger, reorganization, financing, acquisition, or transfer of assets, information may be transferred as part of that transaction, subject to applicable legal requirements and appropriate safeguards.

We do not currently operate an advertising business, sell personal information as a data-broker product, or share personal information with advertising networks for cross-context behavioral advertising as part of the service configuration described by this policy.
International Data Transfers: Zeyrix is intended for international use, and its infrastructure and third-party providers may be located in different countries. Your information may therefore be processed or stored outside your country of residence, including in countries that may provide different levels of data protection.

The countries in which information is processed may depend on the hosting configuration, the provider selected for a particular AI or web-search request, the location of storage infrastructure, and the provider's own operational practices.

Where applicable law requires a specific legal mechanism or safeguard for an international transfer, we will take steps intended to comply with those requirements. Depending on the circumstances, this may include contractual safeguards, adequacy decisions, or other legally recognized transfer mechanisms.
We do not guarantee that all data will be stored in one country or that every provider will process information exclusively within your country of residence.
Data Retention and Deletion: Account Information: We generally retain account records in our database while the associated account exists. Under the current service design, accounts are not automatically deleted after a period of inactivity.

Conversations and Messages: Chat histories and messages are retained in our database and are not automatically deleted under the current service design. They may remain associated with your account until an applicable deletion request is processed or another lawful basis requires or permits continued retention.

Uploaded and Generated Files: Files may be stored in remote object storage, including Cloudflare R2, and may also be stored locally in your browser's IndexedDB. Remote files may be removed automatically as part of backend storage management or operational processes. We do not promise a fixed retention period for every file, and local browser copies may remain even after a remote file has been deleted.

Session and Technical Records: Session information and operational metadata may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary for authentication, security, troubleshooting, and service operation, subject to applicable law and our actual retention configuration.

Third-Party Retention: AI, web-search, hosting, and other providers may maintain their own logs, backups, or records under their respective policies and configurations. Deleting information from our systems does not necessarily delete copies already retained by a third-party provider.

Deletion Requests: If you want your account or associated personal information deleted, contact legal@zeyrix.co. We will review and handle your request in accordance with applicable law. We may need to verify your identity and clarify the scope of the request before acting.

Deletion Limitations: Some information may need to be retained where required by law, necessary to establish or defend legal claims, needed to protect security, or otherwise subject to a lawful retention exception. Where appropriate, information may remain temporarily in backups or technical records until those records are overwritten or removed under applicable retention procedures.

We do not claim that every account, message, file, backup, or provider-side record can be deleted immediately or simultaneously. Where applicable law grants a right to erasure, we will assess the request and take the steps required by that law.
Data Security: We aim to implement reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, disclosure, and misuse.

Such measures may include access controls, authentication mechanisms, restricted infrastructure access, secure communications, and operational monitoring, depending on the relevant system and its implementation.

No website, database, network, AI system, or storage service can be guaranteed to be completely secure. We therefore cannot promise absolute security or that unauthorized access, data loss, or other incidents will never occur.

Because ZeyrixAI is a demonstration service that relies on third-party providers, you should not treat it as a secure repository for confidential, sensitive, regulated, or commercially critical information.
Your Privacy Rights: Depending on your country of residence and the laws that apply to our processing, you may have rights to request access to your personal information, obtain a copy of it, correct inaccurate information, request deletion, restrict or object to certain processing, or receive information in a portable format.

Where processing is based on consent, you may have the right to withdraw that consent. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal, and some processing may continue where another lawful basis applies.
You may also have the right to complain to a competent data protection authority or regulator in your jurisdiction.
To exercise a privacy right, contact legal@zeyrix.co and describe your request. Please avoid including passwords, authentication tokens, or unnecessary sensitive information in your message.

We may request reasonable additional information to verify your identity or authority to make a request. We will respond within the period required by applicable law and may explain where a request cannot be fulfilled in full because of a lawful exception or another applicable limitation.

These rights are not identical in every jurisdiction and may be subject to conditions or exceptions. This policy does not intend to remove or restrict any mandatory rights you have under applicable law.
Legal Bases for Processing: Where applicable data protection law requires us to identify a legal basis for processing, we may rely on the performance of a contract or steps taken at your request before entering into a contract, where processing is necessary to provide the service or perform the requested operation.

We may rely on legitimate interests where permitted by law, including maintaining and securing the service, preventing abuse, troubleshooting technical problems, and protecting our legal rights, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights and interests.
We may rely on consent where required by law or where we choose to request it for a particular processing activity. You may withdraw consent as described in this policy.
We may process information to comply with legal obligations or to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims where an applicable legal basis permits it.

The applicable legal basis depends on the specific processing activity, the service used, your location, and the law that applies. This section does not represent that a single legal basis applies to every category of information or every user.
Children and Age Restrictions: Zeyrix is intended for adults aged 18 and older. Our services are not designed or marketed for children, and we do not knowingly intend to collect personal information from individuals under 18.

If you are under 18, you should not create an account or use ZeyrixAI. If we become aware that personal information has been collected from an individual under 18 in circumstances where it should not have been collected, we will assess the situation and take appropriate steps in accordance with applicable law.
If you believe that an individual under 18 has provided personal information to us, please contact legal@zeyrix.co.
Third-Party Services and Links: Our services may rely on third-party infrastructure, authentication services, AI models, web-search tools, and file storage providers. Their processing of information may be governed by separate privacy policies, terms, and technical configurations.

Authentication through Telegram involves interaction with Telegram's systems. Telegram may process information in accordance with its own policies and the information made available through the authentication flow.
Our website or AI-generated content may include links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy, security, or content practices of third-party websites that we do not control.
We encourage you to review the privacy policies of relevant third-party providers before using features that transmit information to them.
Automated Processing and AI Limitations: ZeyrixAI uses automated systems and AI models to interpret requests, process supplied context, search for information, and generate responses or files.
AI-generated content may contain errors, omissions, outdated information, or fabricated statements. You should independently verify important information before relying on it.

Your prompts and conversation history may be processed by automated systems and external providers to produce responses. Depending on the provider and the operation performed, processing may occur on infrastructure outside Zeyrix's direct control.

ZeyrixAI is currently intended as a demonstration of technical capabilities rather than a service for making decisions that produce legal effects or similarly significant consequences about individuals. Do not use it as the sole basis for employment, lending, healthcare, legal, or other high-impact decisions.
Changes to This Privacy Policy: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes to our services, infrastructure, providers, legal obligations, or data processing practices.
When we make changes, we will update the Last Updated date and publish the revised policy on the relevant website or service.
If a change materially affects how we process personal information, we will provide additional notice or seek consent where required by applicable law.
Your continued use of the services after an updated policy becomes effective does not override any consent requirement or other mandatory right imposed by applicable law.
Contact Us: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, want to exercise a privacy right, or wish to submit a request concerning your personal information, contact us at legal@zeyrix.co.

Zeyrix is currently a developing project, and its final legal operating identity and registration details may be established before launch. We will update this policy with the applicable legal entity or business operator information when those details are finalized.
